system.description: Hardy people who make their homes in the highest peaks. Miners, climbers, and hunters known for their incredible endurance and connection to the stone.
system.traits: Mountain Born: You're acclimated to high altitude and cold environments. Stone Endurance: When you take damage, you can reduce it by 1d10 + your CON modifier (minimum 1). Once per short rest. Sure-Footed: You have advantage on ability checks to avoid being knocked prone or pushed.
